reminders.title: Water break
reminders.message: A few sips now. Your future brain says thanks.

reminders.title: Unfold yourself
reminders.message: Stand up, reach high, and loosen your shoulders.

reminders.title: Snack check
reminders.message: If you're hungry, grab something that will keep you going.

reminders.title: Take a tiny lap
reminders.message: Walk around the room. The code can breathe for a minute.

reminders.title: Give your eyes a horizon
reminders.message: Look about 20 feet away for 20 seconds.

reminders.title: It’s bedtime
reminders.message: You’ve done enough for tonight. Save your work and let the code rest.

windDown.title: Start winding down
windDown.message: Bedtime is in 20 minutes. Wrap up this thought and save your place.

bedtime.title: It’s bedtime
bedtime.message: You’ve done enough for tonight. Save your work and let the code rest.
